shows_data enriched with average tempo (BPM), before the live venue-coordinate join

Source: R/data.R
shiny_shows_data_base.Rd

The base app.R builds its own runtime shows_data from: joins in the live fls_venue_geocoding sheet for coordinates, disambiguates same-named cities, and de-duplicates by gid. Coordinates change if the sheet is edited, so that part must stay a live, runtime join - this object is everything upstream of it.

Usage

shiny_shows_data_base

Format

dataframe with the same rows as shows_data, plus tempo_bpm.

Provenance

Shiny-presentation-only. Produced by build_shiny_precompute from shows_data, duration_data_da, and song_tempo_bpm_data. Not to be confused with the package's own shows_data, which this does not overwrite.

shiny_shows_data_base
